005package org.wpilib.romi;
006
007import org.wpilib.hardware.hal.SimDevice;
008import org.wpilib.hardware.hal.SimDevice.Direction;
009import org.wpilib.hardware.hal.SimDouble;
010
011/**
012 * RomiServo.
013 *
014 * <p>A SimDevice based servo
015 */
016public class RomiServo {
017  private final SimDouble m_simPosition;
018
019  /**
020   * Constructs a RomiServo.
021   *
022   * @param channel the PWM channel the servo is attached to.
023   */
024  public RomiServo(int channel) {
025    OnBoardIO.allocatePWM(channel);
026
027    // We want this to appear on WS as type: "PWM", device: <channel>
028    String simDeviceName = "PWM:" + channel;
029    SimDevice romiServoSimDevice = SimDevice.create(simDeviceName);
030
031    if (romiServoSimDevice != null) {
032      romiServoSimDevice.createBoolean("init", Direction.OUTPUT, true);
033      // This should mimic PWM position [0.0, 1.0]
034      m_simPosition = romiServoSimDevice.createDouble("position", Direction.OUTPUT, 0.5);
035    } else {
036      m_simPosition = null;
037    }
038  }
039
040  /**
041   * Set the servo angle.
042   *
043   * @param angleDegrees Desired angle in degrees
044   */
045  public void setAngle(double angleDegrees) {
046    if (angleDegrees < 0.0) {
047      angleDegrees = 0.0;
048    }
049
050    if (angleDegrees > 180.0) {
051      angleDegrees = 180.0;
052    }
053
054    double pos = angleDegrees / 180.0;
055
056    if (m_simPosition != null) {
057      m_simPosition.set(pos);
058    }
059  }
060
061  /**
062   * Get the servo angle.
063   *
064   * @return Current servo angle
065   */
066  public double getAngle() {
067    if (m_simPosition != null) {
068      return m_simPosition.get() * 180.0;
069    }
070
071    return 90.0;
072  }
073
074  /**
075   * Set the servo position.
076   *
077   * @param position Desired position (Between 0.0 and 1.0)
078   */
079  public void setPosition(double position) {
080    if (position < 0.0) {
081      position = 0.0;
082    }
083
084    if (position > 1.0) {
085      position = 1.0;
086    }
087
088    if (m_simPosition != null) {
089      m_simPosition.set(position);
090    }
091  }
092
093  /**
094   * Get the servo position.
095   *
096   * @return Current servo position
097   */
098  public double getPosition() {
099    if (m_simPosition != null) {
100      return m_simPosition.get();
101    }
102
103    return 0.5;
104  }
105}
